researchTopic: Should the repo deprecate its unproven prompt-injection surfaces (the three always-on directives — comment-hygiene, governor, proof-over-appearance; the Pi subagent-dispatch directive; active-goal briefs; continuity and dist-warning briefs) and keep only the two proven smart injections (the Gate-3 spec-folder question and the skill-advisor recommendation line)?
